description: Add a new custom domain to the active brand. After adding, call verify_domain to check DNS and activate it. hostingMode defaults to 'postking' (our infra serves it — verification checks BOTH an A record and a TXT ownership record). Pass hostingMode: 'self_hosted' when the customer's OWN infra will serve this domain — e.g. a landing page set to self_hosted distribution via set_landing_page_distribution, running against the public landing-pages API on their own server (see the example at https://github.com/bitsandtea/postking-selfhost, or any custom build). Self-hosted domains verify by TXT ownership record only — there's no A record to check, since the domain deliberately does NOT point at PostKing. Mode-match rule: when you later call connect_landing_page_domain, this Domain's hostingMode MUST match the target page's distribution ('postking' <-> 'hosted', 'self_hosted' <-> 'self_hosted') — a mismatch 409s. Set hostingMode here to match the page's distribution (or set the page's distribution to match, via set_landing_page_distribution) before connecting.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. 'myblog.com' (protocol and www stripped automatically)

hostingMode.description: 'postking' (default, our infra serves it) or 'self_hosted' (the customer's own infra serves it; verification is TXT-only). See tool description.

isPrimary.description: Set as primary domain for the brand

name: add_domain
